python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,sys,time,os,sqlite3,shutil

def run(args,timeout=6):
    try: return subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: return None

def s22():
    p=run(["adb","devices"],3)
    if not p: return None
    for line in p.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)>=2 and parts[1]=="device":
            serial=parts[0]
            q=run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","getprop","ro.product.model"],3)
            if q and q.stdout.strip()=="SM-S906B": return serial
    return None

serial=s22()
if not serial:
    m=run(["adb","mdns","services"],6)
    eps=[]
    if m:
        for line in m.stdout.splitlines():
            if "_adb-tls-connect._tcp" in line:
                for token in reversed(line.split()):
                    if re.search(r":\d+$",token):
                        eps.append(token); break
    for ep in eps:
        run(["adb","connect",ep],4); time.sleep(.4)
        serial=s22()
        if serial: break
if not serial:
    print("S22_ADB_UNREACHABLE"); sys.exit(42)

base="/tmp/tracker-auto-gatt-post"
shutil.rmtree(base,ignore_errors=True)
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)

def snapshot(label):
    for name in ("tracker_database","tracker_database-wal","tracker_database-shm"):
        remote="databases/"+name
        p=subprocess.run(["adb","-s",serial,"exec-out","run-as","io.blueeye","sh","-c",f"cat {remote} 2>/dev/null || true"],capture_output=True,timeout=20)
        open(os.path.join(base,f"{label}-{name}"),"wb").write(p.stdout)

def open_copy(label):
    work=os.path.join(base,f"{label}-db")
    for name,suf in (("tracker_database",""),("tracker_database-wal","-wal"),("tracker_database-shm","-shm")):
        src=os.path.join(base,f"{label}-{name}")
        if os.path.exists(src) and os.path.getsize(src)>0:
            shutil.copyfile(src,work+suf)
    con=sqlite3.connect(f"file:{work}?mode=ro",uri=True)
    con.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
    return con

def metrics(label):
    con=open_copy(label)
    now=int(time.time()*1000)
    rows=list(con.execute("""
      select lastProbeTimestamp, connectionStatus, connectionAttempts, gattServices,
             characteristicData, modelNumber, serialNumber, firmwareRevision,
             hardwareRevision, softwareRevision, manufacturerName, batteryLevel, probeError
      from devices
      where lastProbeTimestamp > ?
      order by lastProbeTimestamp desc
    """,(now-20*60*1000,)))
    def ne(v): return v is not None and str(v).strip()!=""
    info={
      "recent_devices":len(rows),
      "with_services":sum(ne(r["gattServices"]) for r in rows),
      "with_characteristics":sum(ne(r["characteristicData"]) for r in rows),
      "with_standard_fields":sum(any(ne(r[k]) for k in ("modelNumber","serialNumber","firmwareRevision","hardwareRevision","softwareRevision","manufacturerName")) or r["batteryLevel"] is not None for r in rows),
      "with_errors":sum(ne(r["probeError"]) for r in rows),
      "attempts_sum":sum(int(r["connectionAttempts"] or 0) for r in rows),
      "newest_probe_age_ms":(-1 if not rows else max(0,now-int(rows[0]["lastProbeTimestamp"]))),
    }
    row=con.execute("select count(*) c,max(timestamp) m from signal_samples where timestamp > ?",(now-2*60*1000,)).fetchone()
    info["samples_2m"]=int(row["c"])
    info["sample_age_ms"]=-1 if row["m"] is None else max(0,now-int(row["m"]))
    con.close()
    print(label.upper()+" "+" ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k,v in info.items()))
    return info

start_epoch=int(time.time())
snapshot("before")
before=metrics("before")
time.sleep(75)
snapshot("after")
after=metrics("after")

log=run(["adb","-s",serial,"logcat","-d","-v","epoch"],12)
txt=log.stdout if log else ""
recent=[]
for line in txt.splitlines():
    m=re.match(r"^(\d+)\.(\d+)\s+",line)
    if m and int(m.group(1)) >= start_epoch-30:
        recent.append(line)
patterns={
 "enabled":r"AutoActiveProbe.*Auto active GATT collection enabled",
 "queued":r"AutoActiveProbe.*Queued auto active GATT probe",
 "started":r"AutoActiveProbe.*Starting auto active GATT probe",
 "timeout":r"AutoActiveProbe.*probe timeout",
 "read_ok":r"BleManager.*Read Char:",
 "read_done":r"BleManager.*Finished reading all characteristics",
 "read_failed":r"BleManager.*Failed to read",
 "conn_failed":r"BleManager.*Connection Failed/Lost|Connection Failed/Lost",
}
counts={k:sum(1 for l in recent if re.search(p,l)) for k,p in patterns.items()}
print("AUTO_GATT_LOG "+" ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k,v in counts.items()))

p=run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","pidof","io.blueeye"],3)
alive=bool(p and p.stdout.strip())
fatal=sum(1 for l in recent if "FATAL EXCEPTION" in l or "ANR in io.blueeye" in l)
print("AUTO_GATT_RESULT recent_device_delta=%d attempts_delta=%d service_device_delta=%d characteristic_device_delta=%d" % (
  after["recent_devices"]-before["recent_devices"],
  after["attempts_sum"]-before["attempts_sum"],
  after["with_services"]-before["with_services"],
  after["with_characteristics"]-before["with_characteristics"],
))
print(f"AUTO_GATT_HEALTH process_alive={'yes' if alive else 'no'} fatal_or_anr={fatal} scanner_samples_2m={after['samples_2m']} scanner_newest_age_ms={after['sample_age_ms']}")
if not alive or fatal:
    sys.exit(44)
PY
